label_definition.entry: First 4-hour open of UTC day t+1
label_definition.positive: Maximum high during t+1..t+14 is at least 3x entry (+200%)

limitations: Current ExchangeInfo omits historical delistings, creating survivorship bias.
The 200% label uses future daily highs; actual fills, gaps, slippage and exchange limits can make the realized return much lower.
OI history is available only for the recent Binance futures window, so OI is an event-enrichment field rather than a one-year validated model factor.
This is observational factor research. Test-period lift can decay and does not imply causal predictability.
